(((source_kind = 'reply'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM community_replies r
  WHERE (r.id = content_translations.source_id)))) OR ((source_kind = 'team'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

   FROM answers a
